classification_notes: Primary: CTrade::BuyLimit/SellLimit arguments did not match library contract (volume,price,symbol,...); secondary: pending expiration policy when relying on defaults/DAY without explicit server-aligned timestamp.
exact_broken_combination: TRADE_ACTION_PENDING sent with price/symbol fields inconsistent with EURUSD + intended limit price because EA passed (volume, symbolString, limitPrice, ...) into API expecting (volume, limitPrice, symbolString, ...). Server returned TRADE_RETCODE_INVALID_EXPIRATION surfaced as msg invalid expiration per ResultRetcodeDescription mapping.

source_lines_responsible.description: BuyLimit/SellLimit called with symbol and entryPriceLimit swapped vs Trade.mqh signature.

exclude_pure_expiration_policy_as_sole_c: REQUEST_SUMMARY in v1.02 logged parser-correct EURUSD and entry=1.16 while trade layer arguments were wrong; fix required both correct pending request shaping and explicit expiration policy in v1.03.
